svg.title: The price estimate is coefficientwise. If |zi|w ≤1, define the envelope of mode A to be the sum, over switch subsets D, of (b(D)) times the absolute coefficient of Q i∈D zi in that mode. The triangle inequality bounds the substituted coefficient by this envelope. Summing its weighted price and using submultiplicativity gives at most P D b(D) ≤c. Thus a paid scalar switching model produces the local polynomial price required by restoration.
